about: The two SPECIAL buttons as V1's melee specials: each fires its skill's own move-defs row on its own cooldown (RPG-game trunk duel.ts:253-254,288-290,383-391). Slot 1 = the hero's day-one skill (src/fight/skill-defs.json:20, dayOne: pommel); slot 2 = the pre-filled second special (src/fight/sandbox-rules-defs.json specialPick, slot2Default: cleave). Cooldown = rules-defs.json skillCooldown 900 ticks, spent at commitment.
